name: Tran Bao Satter
office: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Tran Bao Satter is a regional sales executive. She says her experience helps her listen to the community and bring people together to work on common goals. District meeting minutes show she reported on a school Color Run that raised $28,000 for the PTA.
